first:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE independent square 1:1 production keyframe of a refined miniature paper transaction apparatus for a Chinese academic cultural-policy ABM exhibition. Contemporary precision paper engineering, warm-white cotton cardstock, charcoal ink and one vermilion accent, clean ivory seamless tabletop, soft upper-left light, believable paper folds and contact shadows. Camera elevated three-quarter view, whole subject centered with generous breathing room, no collage.

On one compact ivory bookstore counter are exactly THREE related objects: (1) a single closed cream clothbound book lying on the left, a short narrow vermilion bookmark visible, exact black Chinese cover title "阅读"; (2) one ivory cultural voucher card resting flat on the counter foreground, with a thin tasteful vermilion printed rectangular border and exact large red text "消费券", NO denomination or numbers; (3) on the right a small paper clamp verification gate made of two upright ivory supports and one hinged vermilion-faced ivory latch spanning between them. The latch is currently horizontal and CLOSED, just above the counter, with a visible round paper pivot on its left support. The voucher's leading edge rests immediately BEFORE the gate, not underneath, showing neutral awaiting-check state. Book, voucher, gate distinct and fully visible. Small exact black label on front of counter "书店". No other print.

The latch should be physically able to pivot upward around the same left hinge in the next keyframe, leaving the voucher and book stationary. Avoid decorative prop clutter, no wallet, people, hands, money, coins, computers, metal, wood grain, numbers, successful transaction checkmark, arrows, implied revenue, stock counts, neon, gold, flowers, antique calligraphy or watermark. It's a designed physical interface metaphor, not data.
last: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is the exact FIRST keyframe of a paper transaction apparatus. Make the LAST stationary keyframe of the SAME apparatus. Lock the square framing, camera, light, background, counter corners, book, narrow bookmark, voucher and gate posts to exactly the same identity and position. All text remains exactly "阅读" on book, "消费券" on voucher and "书店" on counter; do not add or distort print. Change ONLY the existing vermilion-faced paper latch: rotate it upward about 65 degrees on the SAME existing circular hinge at the left post, lifting its rounded right tip into the clean empty space above. Preserve latch length, width, rounded end, red face and ivory edge; hinge center and both support posts remain stationary. This is the open/permitted physical gate pose. Add only the natural small local shadow changes. The single voucher card and single closed book remain where they were, no movement, no exchange, no implication of additional items or revenue. No new props, numbers, arrows, checkmarks, words, icons, hands, particles or glow. Whole lifted latch must remain inside the original frame.
